name: Dare dice
summary: Two big dice on a felt tray: one with six faces from the chat, one with six gentle dares the chat came up with; roll and they tumble and land, the person rolled does the dare or passes (a pass costs a point), best of six rolls.
useWhen: truth or dare but just dares
something dumb and fun for tonight
roll for who has to text their mom
party game for the six of us
dontUseWhen: picking who does a real chore or pays (use chore-wheel or bill-roulette)
anything risky, mean or embarrassing about one person
a plain random pick (use a spinner)

text.description: A gentle, kind dare in sentence case

icon.description: The picture on the dare die

dares.description: Exactly six gentle dares from the chat

rolls.description: Rolls so far: who got rolled, which dare (0 to 5), and whether they did it
